# Channel Core for DeepSeek Harness (community fork)
简体中文 · DeepSeek Harness · Security · Differences from upstream
Repository: https://github.com/firstdreamlh/dsh-feishu-channel
**One plugin for Discord and Feishu/Lark channels.** It owns the channel layer — identity verificati
on, DM session binding, message delivery and streaming progress — while agents, history and task exe
cution stay in native DSH.
- 📱 **Scan to set up**: create or connect a Feishu bot by QR code, then scan again to open a direct

chat — no copying secrets by hand
- 🔗 **Two channels, one set of rules**: Discord and Feishu share o
wner claiming, identity verification and session binding, so two accounts can map to one native Sess

ion
- 📊 **Streaming progress cards**: thinking, drafts and tool calls roll in place, then collapse i

nto a process record
- 🎛️ **`/model` picker card**: one searchable dropdown, apply with a second cli

ck so a long list cannot change the model by accident
- ❓ **Ask User interactions**: answer inside t

he card; the card turns into a read-only receipt afterwards
- 📤 **Proactive delivery**: `channel_sen

d` pushes text, images and files to a bound conversation with idempotent retries
- 🎨 **This fork**:
the finished Feishu answer card renders at 16px (17px on mobile) for phone reading
> This repository is a fork of dsh-channel-core (MIT). Every upstream capability is kept; the change
s are small reading-experience fixes for Feishu direct messages. The full list lives in docs/FORK.md
are small reading-experience fixes for Feishu direct messages. The full list lives in docs/FORK.md.
## Features
- Discord and Feishu adapters live in the same package with independent credentials and connection l

ifecycles.
- Map verified direct messages from the same owner to a shared **native DSH session** whe

n explicitly configured.
- Durable inbound receipts, serialized session admission, and native steer/

queue/interrupt handling avoid replaying messages.
- Native Ask User interactions and progress/statu

s integration preserve conversational continuity.
- Owner verification guards personal-memory access
and cross-channel session transitions.
## Proactive outbound messaging
Channel Core supports agent-initiated outbound messages without a preceding inbound message. The onl
y model-facing channel tool, `channel_send({ text?, imagePath?, filePath?, bindingId?, idempotencyKe
y? })`, sends to the current native Session's existing and currently authorized Feishu or Discord de
stination. It has no archive search/read actions or news-specific tools. The trusted host API `ctx.c
hannelCore.sendToBoundSession({ sessionId, text, idempotencyKey, bindingId?, source? })` remains ava
ilable to schedulers and other plugins; `outboundTargets(sessionId)` returns eligible binding IDs wi
thout exposing recipient IDs.
- **Tool scope:** One call sends text, one Feishu image or one Feishu file. File paths must be withi
n the current workspace and are uploaded as media, not sent as a Markdown path. To persist scheduled

output to conversation history, use native DSH Schedule bound to the relevant Session.
- **Scope:**
A session can send only to its own eligible bindings. Multiple bindings require an explicit `bindin
gId`; arbitrary recipient IDs and cross-session delivery are not accepted. Group allowlists and curr

ent DM/owner permission are checked again on send.
- **Delivery:** Uses the existing durable outbox
and platform send adapters, with state `pending`, `sent`, `failed`, or `uncertain`. Reusing a stable
idempotency key does not send the same message twice. A potentially delivered but unacknowledged me

ssage is **not** blindly retried.
- **Automation:** Jobs can call `channel_send` after creating a re
port (e.g. a scheduled financial report), or trusted plugins can call `sendToBoundSession` directly.
This does **not** automatically broadcast every scheduled result, and it does not grant an agent pe

rmission to send to arbitrary accounts.
- **Testing:** `npm test` runs dependency-free public regres
sions. `npm run test:host` runs the broader integration suite inside a configured DSH developer envi
ronment with host peer dependencies. Live Feishu/Discord delivery has been separately exercised loca
lly; CI cannot verify third-party credentials.
## Streaming, Ask User and commands
Discord streams thinking, draft and tool activity in a rolling progress message. Committed interim t
ext can appear as a native blockquote in the completed message, separate from the final answer; unpu
blished/private reasoning is not promoted to public draft text. Live previews show 📝 without artific
asoning is not promoted to public draft text. Live previews show 📝 without artificial section names.
Feishu supports CardKit component streaming with an IM-card fallback. Draft and thinking have indepe
ndent visibility switches; disabling thinking does not hide public draft text. Completed turns may r
etain a collapsed 📝 过程记录 panel when enabled. Refresh limits and optional runtime footers are channel
llapsed 📝 过程记录 panel when enabled. Refresh limits and optional runtime footers are channel-specific.
[该节后续省略]
## Security and operational boundaries
A channel owner is verified per bot account; group conversations and unverified users must not inher
it personal-memory authority. Session mapping decisions are audited and cannot silently reuse sessio
ns from another workspace. The native Host manages agent execution, cancellations, jobs, and saved h
istories. The plugin keeps independent delivery and receipt state, not a second model engine.
Settings and channel files are local to DSH; do not upload credentials, binding databases, or histor
ical messages. Source template: config.example.json.
